author: Temminck, 1836
status: 여름철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 이동기에도 드물게 기록
habitat: 숲이 있는 해안 섬, 침엽수림 속 어두운 계곡, 연못가
summary: 제주도, 부산, 하태도, 금오도 등 남해안 일부 섬에 간혹 나타나는 철새이다. 홀로 지내 눈에 잘 띄지 않으며, 숲이 있는 해안 섬에서 땅속 벌레나 곤충, 달팽이, 물고기 따위를 먹는 모습이 가끔 보인다. 삼나무 같은 침엽수가 자란 어두운 계곡이나 연못가에 내려 먹이를 찾고, 밤에는 먼 거리를 날아다니거나 땅 위를 조용히 걷는다. 둥지는 땅에서 7~20m 높이의 나무 위에 지으며, 세계적으로는 일본과 러시아에 분포한다.

art.subject: Japanese Night Heron (Gorsachius goisagi), adult in the breeding season, as seen on wooded southern Korean islands from May to August: head and neck dull chestnut-brown with fine dark vermiculation, the crown slightly darker, without long plumes; upperparts warm brown finely vermiculated dark brown; folded flight feathers blackish with rufous-chestnut tips; chin and throat buff with a dark brown stripe down the centre of the foreneck; breast and belly buff, boldly streaked dark brown, with some blackish and white feathers at the sides of the breast. Short, thick bill, dark grey with a bluish-grey base and a slightly arched ridge; bare lores pale yellowish-green; iris bright yellow; legs dull yellowish-green.
art.pose: walking quietly on the forest floor near water, side view
art.scene: Korean southern coastal island: a dark conifer-lined ravine with a small pond; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on the forest floor: dull chestnut-brown head and neck, finely vermiculated warm brown upperparts, dark brown stripe down the buff foreneck, streaked buff underparts, short thick dark grey bill, pale yellowish-green lores, bright yellow iris, yellowish-green legs

adult in flight seen from the side and above: rufous-brown wing coverts, broad black band across the middle of the wing formed by the flight feathers, rufous-chestnut tips to the flight feathers, neck drawn in
art.build: Medium-small, stocky heron, about 49cm long, a little smaller than Black-crowned Night Heron; thick neck usually held hunched, rounded head with at most a short nuchal tuft. Bill short and thick, no longer than the head, much stubbier than in typical herons, with a gently curved culmen. Legs fairly short and stout, yellowish-green. Short tail. Walks slowly and quietly on the forest floor. In flight broad rounded wings: rufous-brown coverts, a broad blackish band across the flight feathers and rufous-chestnut tips; neck retracted.
avoid: Do not paint a black crown and crest or white-tipped primaries — those mark Malayan Night Heron (Gorsachius melanolophus).
Do not paint white spots on the back or wings (juvenile Black-crowned Night Heron).
Do not give it a long, slender, dagger-shaped bill or a long thin neck.
Do not paint a grey or black back; the upperparts are rufous-brown.
